title: Automated Sentiment and Hate Speech Analysis of Facebook Data by Employing Multilingual Transformer Models
findings: The study found that a significant portion of content from 648 far-right Hindutva Facebook pages is hateful (11.71%) and has negative sentiment (36.74%). There is a strong overlap between the top actors and page categories spreading both types of content, with self-declared supporter pages of Hindutva identified as top propagators. Hateful content was found to be overwhelmingly negative in sentiment (8.62% of total content was both hateful and negative, compared to 1.09% being hateful and positive).
references: A. Belew and K. Massanari. 2018. "Social Movement Mobilization and Online Hate: A Case Study of the Alternative Right”.

measurement_description: Hate speech and negative sentiment analysis on content from far-right Hindutva Facebook pages, specifically targeting anti-minority and anti-Muslim narratives.
